title: Natural Language Processing (cross-listed with EECS 498.007)
term: Fall (year not stated in source; exam dates Oct 11 / Dec 14-15)
workloadNotes: Four programming assignments (35% total, up to 3 days late at 10%/day penalty), two exams (20% each), a course project (20%), and class participation (5%, including iClicker responses, Piazza engagement, and rotating "OneCoolThing" team presentations on recent NLP research).
prerequisitesText: For EECS 498.007 students: EECS 281 Data Structures and Algorithms.
textbooks: D. Jurafsky and R. Martin, Speech and Language Processing, 2nd ed. (required)
C. Manning and H. Schutze, Foundations of Statistical Natural Language Processing (recommended)
